==Characteristics==
==={{BotW|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract|Silver Lizalfos}}
Silver Lizalfos are a strong variant of [[Lizalfos]], surpassing both [[Blue Lizalfos]] and [[Black Lizalfos]] due to the influence of [[Calamity Ganon]]'s dark magic.<ref name="BotW Hyrule Compendium 2"/> They have a high health of 864 and carry the strongest variants of Lizalfos [[Weapon]]s. They attack [[Link]] by hitting him, spitting streams of water, and striking him with their tongue. Silver Lizalfos are capable of swimming and spitting water at Link from the water. Link can defeat Silver Lizalfos with any Weapon or [[Bows in Breath of the Wild|Bow]]. When defeated, Silver Lizalfos may drop [[Lizalfos Horn]]s, [[Lizalfos Talon]]s, [[Lizalfos Tail]]s, [[Amber]], [[Opal]], [[Ruby|Rubies]], [[Sapphire]]s, and [[Diamond]]s.

==={{TotK|-}}===
{{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Silver Lizalfos}}
{{Stub|TotK}}
Silver Lizalfos retain the same overall appearance as in {{BotW}}. Their primary physical difference is the shape of their nasal horns, which resemble long, red scythe blades with red edges and golden swirling decorations.

==Other Appearances==
==={{AoC|-}}===
{{Noncanon|Start}}
{{Stub|AoC}}
